about: What enters a bot's main chat (shared/chat-relevance.ts, #3581). The same cases run on the server, the desktop and the phone. place: where a row of that origin and signal goes (card, whole, folded, trace, out). origin: who a thread's turn was for, read from the thread's fields. signal: what a routine run's row is.

place.name: anything that waits is a card, whoever the turn was for
a routine's question is a card
a bot's thread that waits on the person is a card
an AI client's thread that waits on the person is a card
a problem in the person's conversation is a card
a routine's problem is a card
a problem in a bot's thread that needs the person is a card
a problem in an AI client's thread that needs the person is a card
the answer to the person is whole
the bot's notes and steps fold behind the turn's row
a background task's answer to the person's message is whole
the answer of a task the bot opened itself folds
a routine's result posts when the routine posts its results
a routine's result posts when a person started the run
a routine's result stays in its runs otherwise
a routine's final words are not an answer to the person
a routine's work stays in its runs
an answer written to another bot leaves its trace, never its words
a bot's result leaves its trace
a bot's work leaves its trace
an AI client's request leaves one quiet line
an AI client's result leaves one quiet line
an AI client's turn that said nothing leaves one quiet line

origin.name: an AI client's conversation over MCP
a thread a bot opened that the person wrote in is theirs

signal.name: a team that needs input waits
a run waiting on a card of the person waits
a failed run is a problem
a blocked run is a problem
a run completed with problems is a problem
a run with items for the person is a problem
works again after problems is said once
a finished run with a report is a result
a finished run with nothing to report is work
a run a person started shows from its start
a run a person started that waits on nobody still shows
a scheduled run while it runs is work
a run waiting on a teammate is work
a missed run is work (its passing banner says it)
